title: Creamy Granny Smith Apple Crumble Cheesecake (The Vivaldi Way)
originalTitle: Creamy Granny Smith Apple Crumble Cheesecake (The Vivaldi Way)
ingredients: Graham Cracker Crust: 1.5 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1 tsp cinnamon, 6 tbsp melted butter
Spiced Apple Compote: 4 Granny Smith apples (peeled and diced), 3 tbsp butter, 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1.5 tsp cinnamon, squeeze of lemon juice, pinch of salt
Cheesecake Filling: 24 oz (3 blocks) cream cheese (room temp), 3/4 cup sugar, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 tbsp vanilla extract, 3 large eggs
Oat Crumble Topping: 1/2 cup flour, 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp salt, 4 tbsp cold butter
instructions: Cook the diced Granny Smith apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice, and salt over medium-high heat until tender and all excess liquid has cooked off; cool.
Mix graham cracker crumbs, cinnamon, and melted butter; press firmly into the bottom and slightly up the sides of a parchment-lined, foil-wrapped 9-inch springform pan.
Beat room-temperature cream cheese and sugar until silky smooth, blend in sour cream and vanilla, then mix in eggs one at a time on low speed. Pour into crust.
Spoon the cooked cinnamon apples and the oat-brown-sugar crumble evenly over the top. Bake in a water bath at 325°F (165°C) for 60–65 minutes, cool slowly, and chill 6 hours before slicing.
